feeding_claim.verbatim: SkyLines beef eat only grass their entire lives, just as ruminant animals are designed to do.

availability.note: Beef page update dated 2/27/26 says all 2026 beef is reserved; reservations open in January for previous customers and February for everyone else.

notes: Scout 2026-11-24: read homepage (index.htm), beef, pigs, about, management practices and contact pages (no FAQ or shop page exists; Philosophy, Herstory and Links pages not opened). Sells whole, half and quarter beef and whole or half pigs by reservation with a deposit, priced by hanging weight plus processing at C&L Locker or Potlatch Pack near Moscow; beef and pig pages both say free delivery to Lewiston, Moscow, Coeur d'Alene, Sandpoint and Post Falls and that shipping is not available. Beef page also says the cattle are never fed grain.
